note: Independent audit against RFC 4724 Section 4.2. Positive subtest drives Peer.finishCollisionHandoff on an Established session that received GR families and proves the previous TCP connection is closed with 0 bytes read and io.EOF (no NOTIFICATION sent) while the new connection remains retained in peer.inbound and readable/writable (byte written by newClient received on newServer). Negative subtest drives finishCollisionHandoff without GR families and proves the new connection receives NOTIFICATION Cease/Connection Collision (6/7) while the previous TCP session remains open (oldSession.Conn() != nil).
